name: hidden-view
description: Hidden View — a health check for your news diet. npm workspaces: the Python engine is at examples/, the shared client core at packages/core, the web app at web/, the Expo app at mobile/.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ih/core && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace @ih/mobile
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @ih/core && npm test --workspace web && npm test --workspace @ih/mobile
